pair_rules: Choose distinct affine points with nonzero x and y, and distinct x coordinates.
Use lexicographic point inventory and seeded sampling without replacement of ordered pairs.
Freeze target JSON and its SHA256 before any fit. Do not condition on relation labels.
Report the realized quadratic-character strata and sign-pattern eligibility; never replace ineligible pairs.
t_selection: Ascending first four t in [1,64] satisfying signed t^2 == target x mod p; fewer allowed and reported.
ordinate_rule: Choose z0 in [0,p-1] with t*z0 == target y mod p; lifted y=t*(z0+p*j).
dependency_rules: Both coefficients nonzero with gcd(|a|,|b|)=1; both points certified non-torsion; exact [a]P+[b]Q=O. Optional torsion-term extensions reported separately.
No dependency accepted solely from point membership, rank bounds, descent-image collapse or finite-field checks.
Only synthetic relation certification; no key-recovery implementation.
acceptance: Integral A,B only; reject zero discriminant and bad reduction at source p.
Exact rational point equations and both reductions match the frozen targets.
Deduplicate identical (A,B,P,Q) without hiding the original rejection and proposal counts.
controls: Historical n=-1793 and 181: independent modulo torsion.
Planted exact doubling: dependent and explicitly excluded from success count.
Opposite-sign distinct-prime fits: must obey H-XEDN-0ea2b6 if all hypotheses verified.
metrics: eligible cells by prime and sign pattern
construction, factorization, certificate and relation-check wall time and operation counters
required_before_execution: Independent audit of conditional lemma and parameter formulas.
Target manifest frozen and committed, planted and independent controls pass.
Implement a synthetic-only runner with hard bounds and per-stage cost accounting.
Create and approve frozen EXP contract; this draft consumes no approved execution capacity.
interpretation: At most 591872 proposal cells before deduplication; factor/search costs not bounded by that count.
Squareclass compatibility does not establish a dependency.
A rational dependency certificate on tiny synthetic instances is not a general speedup.
Zero after exhaustive bounded checks excludes only this finite domain; unresolved rank is not independence.
